# CLI reference

> **Audience:** deck authors, agents and contributors · **Generated from:** src/cli/*.ts · **Version:** 0.4.2

Run from a clone with `node dist/slidecraft.mjs <command>` (zero install) or `npx tsx src/cli/main.ts <command>` during development. When stdout is not a terminal, commands that support `--json` print JSON.

## `validate`

Validate deck.yaml against the schema and layout contracts

```
Usage: slidecraft slidecraft validate [options] <deck>

Validate deck.yaml against the schema and layout contracts

Arguments:
  deck        path to deck.yaml

Options:
  --json      machine-readable output
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## `check`

Validate, lay out and run QA (fit, titles, sources, geometry, contrast) without writing files

```
Usage: slidecraft slidecraft check [options] <deck>

Validate, lay out and run QA (fit, titles, sources, geometry, contrast) without
writing files

Arguments:
  deck        path to deck.yaml

Options:
  --json      machine-readable output
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## `build`

Build the deck into PPTX / PDF / PNG / HTML

```
Usage: slidecraft slidecraft build [options] <deck>

Build the deck into PPTX / PDF / PNG / HTML

Arguments:
  deck                  path to deck.yaml

Options:
  -f, --format <list>   comma-separated: pptx,pdf,png,html,onepager,docx
  --pptx-engine <id>    auto | pptxgenjs | artifact-tool
  --pdf-engine <id>     auto | native | html | pptx-convert
  -o, --out <dir>       output directory (default: <deck dir>/dist)
  --preview-width <px>  PNG preview width
  --json                machine-readable output
  -h, --help            display help for command
```

## `new`

Scaffold a deck workspace (brief.yaml + deck.yaml) under ./slidecraft/<slug>

```
Usage: slidecraft slidecraft new [options] <goal-or-slug>

Scaffold a deck workspace (brief.yaml + deck.yaml) under ./slidecraft/<slug>

Arguments:
  goal-or-slug       what the deck must achieve, in your words, or a kebab-case
                     id

Options:
  --dir <dir>        parent directory (default: "slidecraft")
  --goal <text>      what must be true after the audience sees the deck
  --audience <text>  who the deck is for
  --json             machine-readable output
  -h, --help         display help for command
```

## `choose`

Record the chosen template in brief.yaml (checkpoint 2)

```
Usage: slidecraft slidecraft choose [options]

Record the chosen template in brief.yaml (checkpoint 2)

Options:
  -b, --brief <path>  brief.yaml
  --option <A|B|C>    one of the suggested options
  --storyline <id>
  --theme <id>
  -h, --help          display help for command
```

## `scaffold`

Create a ghost deck.yaml from the chosen storyline (one slide per slot)

```
Usage: slidecraft slidecraft scaffold [options]

Create a ghost deck.yaml from the chosen storyline (one slide per slot)

Options:
  -b, --brief <path>  brief.yaml
  -o, --out <path>    deck.yaml path (default: next to the brief)
  --force             overwrite an existing deck.yaml
  -h, --help          display help for command
```

## `gallery`

Render contact sheets (storyline × theme) and layout thumbnails into docs/gallery

```
Usage: slidecraft slidecraft gallery [options]

Render contact sheets (storyline × theme) and layout thumbnails into
docs/gallery

Options:
  -o, --out <dir>      output directory
  --themes <list>      comma-separated theme ids (default: each storyline's
                       recommended themes)
  --storylines <list>  comma-separated storyline ids (default: all)
  --hero               also render docs/media/hero.png for the README
  -h, --help           display help for command
```

## `theme import`

Create a theme from a .pptx / .potx: colours, fonts and logo

```
Usage: slidecraft slidecraft theme import [options] <file>

Create a theme from a .pptx / .potx: colours, fonts and logo

Arguments:
  file              brand template (.pptx or .potx)

Options:
  --id <id>         kebab-case theme id, e.g. contoso
  --name <name>     display name
  -o, --out <dir>   output folder (default: ./slidecraft-theme next to the file)
  --font-dir <dir>  folder with the brand font files (TTF/OTF) to measure them
                    exactly
  --json            machine-readable output
  -h, --help        display help for command
```

## `import`

Import an existing .pptx into a draft deck.yaml (text, tables, charts, images, notes)

```
Usage: slidecraft slidecraft import [options] <file>

Import an existing .pptx into a draft deck.yaml (text, tables, charts, images,
notes)

Arguments:
  file               the presentation to import

Options:
  -o, --out <dir>    output folder (default: ./slidecraft/<file-name>)
  --id <id>          deck id
  --theme <id|path>  theme for the draft (default: "consulting-classic")
  --render           also render the original to original.pdf
                     (PowerPoint/LibreOffice) for a visual redesign pass
  --json             machine-readable output
  -h, --help         display help for command
```

## `fix`

```
Usage: slidecraft slidecraft fix [options] <deck>

Fit-fix loop: list texts that do not fit with an exact character budget, or
apply rewrites by JSON pointer

Arguments:
  deck                  path to deck.yaml

Options:
  --apply <fixes.json>  JSON list of { pointer, text } rewrites to write into
                        the YAML
  --json                machine-readable output
  -h, --help            display help for command
```

## `calibrate`

Check that line breaks match PowerPoint for a theme's fonts (needs PowerPoint or LibreOffice + poppler)

```
Usage: slidecraft slidecraft calibrate [options]

Check that line breaks match PowerPoint for a theme's fonts (needs PowerPoint or
LibreOffice + poppler)

Options:
  --theme <id|path>  theme id or theme JSON path (default: "consulting-classic")
  -o, --out <dir>    output folder (default: "slidecraft/calibration")
  --json             machine-readable output
  -h, --help         display help for command
```
